title: Transcript
$comment: Internal bookkeeping slot (user_visible: false in artifact_contract.json). Holds the ASR-derived dialogue segments consumed only by Phase 03 sound designer. Plain domain-shaped JSON — NOT subject to the user-visible artifact protocol.

segments.description: Time-ordered dialogue segments. May be empty when input has no speech (music / noise).

start.description: Segment start in float seconds, time-origin = media start (= 0).

text.description: Transcribed text content for this segment.

source.description: Provenance of this transcript. Phase 07 records this in audio_design_result for audit.

source_slot.description: When source=artifact_reuse, the upstream slot name we copied from.
